title: Search-Eval Engine Profile
description: How to reach the retailer's REAL shopper-facing search engine, and the proof that it is the real one. L01 is the single biggest source of invalid evaluations: a WooCommerce Store API returned 0 for a term the storefront answered with 6. verified_against_live_ui is required precisely so that mistake cannot pass silently.

kind.description: storefront_html is the Woo shopper path. storefront_graphql is Shopify's AND-of-prefix predictive query. json_api is the enterprise organic endpoint, which MUST exclude sponsored results.

results_path.description: JSON pointer or CSS selector locating the organic result list.

excludes_sponsored.description: L09. Required true for json_api on enterprise stores (e.g. include_sponsored=false).

carousel_exclusions.description: L09. Selectors whose descendants must never be read as organic results. A naive a[href*='/p/'] captured 'Recommended for you' tiles and made the store look far worse than it was.

verified_against_live_ui.description: L01 gate. A control term run through the profiled path must match what a shopper sees in the live UI. Without this the profile is unvalidated and no capture may proceed.

pacing.description: L11. Bot protection rate-limits on CUMULATIVE calls per visitor, and the block is long-lived. Recover by waiting, never by rotating identities - that is bypassing bot protection and is prohibited.

known_redirects.description: L10. Brand queries that 302 to a curated brand page return 0 from the keyword API while the shopper sees thousands. These are a STRENGTH misread as total failure.
